reason: Umbrella for Postgres work in this repo: schema changes, grants, row-level security proofs and engine data rules are one class (database changes), not five separate skills. Absorbs database-access-rules and engine-schema-change; their detail is carried as references.

When the step-date defaults changed from placeholders to the decided numbers, the agent first grepped the locked proofs for the old values, found they were only set by the tests themselves, and then updated the migration header, seed descriptions and the branch note together. That order is the reusable rule.
